label: e2e_stopped
title: Composition · App stopped
body: Internal abstract-composition panel, not application UI. The in-process daemon has stopped. Durable server work may continue.

label: e2e_closed
title: Composition · Window closed
body: Internal abstract-composition panel, not application UI. The app and daemon remain running. Uploads, polling and server processing may continue.

label: e2e_offline
title: Composition · Daemon unavailable
body: Internal abstract-composition panel, not application UI. The shell cannot make a new daemon call. Durable receipts and server jobs remain separate.

label: e2e_signed_out
title: Composition · Sign in
body: Internal abstract-composition panel, not application UI. This abstraction begins after first run. Sign-in selects one of two accounts and creates usable enrollment.

label: e2e_pending
title: Composition · Traces
body: Internal abstract-composition panel, not application UI. A source revision awaits preview. Consent and account/device inputs are recorded separately.

label: e2e_preview
title: Composition · Review trace
body: Internal abstract-composition panel, not application UI. The stored preview pin identifies the revision, consent and account/device inputs. Approval is a separate action.

label: e2e_approved
title: Composition · Approved
body: Internal abstract-composition panel, not application UI. The daemon rechecks enrollment, source revision and approval inputs before a send.

label: e2e_sending
title: Composition · Sending
body: Internal abstract-composition panel, not application UI. A request may be in flight. Sending does not establish a durable server receipt or a final verdict.

label: e2e_retry
title: Composition · Try again
body: Internal abstract-composition panel, not application UI. The transport did not establish local receipt status. A durable receipt may already exist; replay keeps its owner and bundle.

label: e2e_history
title: Composition · History
body: Internal abstract-composition panel, not application UI. The daemon has a receipt. Visible history follows cached reads; server Admission, Review, Score and Settle may be ahead.

label: e2e_credit
title: Composition · Credit
body: Internal abstract-composition panel, not application UI. The last app read includes earned credit. Pipeline NEAR issuance and account NEAR AI/referral payouts have independent state.

label: e2e_withdrawn
title: Composition · Taken back
body: Internal abstract-composition panel, not application UI. The last app read reports withdrawal. Logical exclusion precedes index cleanup and retention-governed object purge.
